kitDescription: Delta: Ninja Thief is a Water-element MG Defender on Burst II whose offense is almost entirely support-shaped. Every time the team enters Full Burst she poisons the boss with Ninjutsu Acid Bomb, making it take 12% more damage from everyone for 15 seconds; when she personally fires her burst she adds a second, separate 8% damage-taken debuff for 10 seconds and pumps her own ATK by 15.04%. Her burst also hands the whole squad +20% Distributed Damage and a flat ATK grant worth 15% of her own ATK for 10 seconds, then hits the boss for 170% of her final ATK as distributed damage. Her second skill is a defensive fork decided by squad composition: alone among Defenders she taunts and shields herself (at battle start and again every 200 rounds fired); alongside another Defender she instead goes untargetable, drains HP from her own damage, and pulses a stored team heal every 4 seconds. None of the shielding, taunting, camouflage or healing changes damage on the partless scope-lock boss.

skill1.blindSaid: S6 byte-identical; S5 asserts count === fullBurstStart count, boss-held (casterIdx/targetIdx null), lands on FB-start frames
skill1.formulaCheck: Damage Taken sits in the boss-side Taken bucket (damage-calculation.md 1g) and benefits every ally's instances; 'entering Full Burst' is a team-state trigger, not a caster trigger
skill1.explanation: Fires 5x over 180s (once per FB window), 15s window verified as exactly 900 frames; removing it lowers liter, helm AND dnt totals, so the team-wide routing is proven, not asserted.

skill1.blindSaid: S6 identical; S5 asserts count === her own burstCast count and targetSlug === slug
skill1.formulaCheck: plain ATK ▲% dilutes into effectiveAtk's (1 + ΣATK%) sum (1a) — correct for a kit line with no 'of caster's ATK' qualifier
skill1.explanation: Applied once per her own cast; teammate totals are byte-identical when it is stripped, proving self-scope rather than a leaked team buff.

skill1.driverSaid: burstCast -> target enemy -> damageTakenPct 8, durationSec 10 (kept as a DISTINCT block from the 12%)
skill1.blindSaid: S6 identical; S5 asserts an 8 and a 12 both exist and no merged 20 is ever emitted
skill1.formulaCheck: distinct named effects (Ninjutsu Acid Bomb vs Ninjutsu Hyper Acid Bomb) = different scopes, so they stack additively inside Taken rather than refreshing each other (game-mechanics.md 11)
skill1.explanation: 'Enemies within attack range nearest to the crosshair' collapses to the single partless boss. Discriminated by frame: the 8% lands on her cast frame while the 12% lands ~52f later on the FB-start frame, and stripping it collapses the nuke's taken multiplier 1.0800 -> 1.0000 — which independently confirms the burst-cast boundary rule (the nuke sees the 8% but not the 12%).

skill2.driverSaid: passive -> self -> shield maxHpPct 12.25, durationSec 10, mode 'solo defender'
skill2.formulaCheck: no shield HP pool in v1; the shield exists as an event channel for a teammate's 'shielded' trigger. Magnitude is unrepresentable, not mis-encoded
skill2.explanation: The negative formation gate ('no OTHER Defender ally') is not expressible — the schema has teamHas but no teamLacks — so both branches are user-selectable modes with the solo branch as default. That default is WRONG in any comp containing a second Defender (crown, the stock control-comp B2, is one), but skill2 is damage-inert either way and the driver records this as ☑3.

skill2.explanation: Correctly handled: the taunt itself is dropped but the branch status it confers still gates the two Attract-scoped blocks, which is the only observable part of the line.

skill2.blindSaid: S2b UNMODELED / fully inert; S6 unmodeled
skill2.explanation: Adding or removing it moves nothing in v1. Recorded, not silently dropped.

skill2.driverSaid: modeled as an event-only self heal on shotFired, mode 'with defender ally'; the 11.22% magnitude gap is stated in the note (☑4) but NOT listed in unmodeled.skill2

skill2.formulaCheck: heal effects carry no HP quantity in v1, so only the recovery EVENT channel is representable
skill2.explanation: The driver models MORE than the blind here (keeping the self-recovery channel for a future on-recovery consumer), which is the safer direction under the tandem rule. Bookkeeping nit only: the magnitude gap lives in the note's ☑ list rather than in unmodeled.skill2 — recorded, so not a gotcha.

skill2.driverSaid: hitCount 200 -> self shield maxHpPct 12.25 / 10s, mode 'solo defender'
skill2.blindSaid: S6 identical; S5 asserts the fixture actually exceeds 200 rounds (non-vacuity)
skill2.formulaCheck: hitCount counts rounds; MG hitsPerShot 1, ammo 300, so the trigger recurs within and across magazine cycles
skill2.explanation: Correctly gated to the Attract (solo-Defender) branch, so it cannot fire spuriously in the with-Defender branch. Damage-inert, but the gate and cadence are right.

skill2.kitLine: every 4 sec in Injection: IFAK team heal
skill2.driverSaid: hitCount 200 -> allies heal, mode 'with defender ally', justified in the note as '☑2 proxy for the 4s timer — no timed-interval trigger exists'
skill2.blindSaid: S6 used {kind:'interval', sec:4} -> allies heal; S2b specified interval sec:4 and told the judge to assert steady 4s periodicity
skill2.formulaCheck: game-mechanics.md §9 and damage-calculation.md §2b both document a live `interval` trigger ('fires every N sec, first at t=N'; snow-white S2a is the shipped carrier), so the stated reason for the proxy is false
skill2.explanation: The cadence is encoded as a round-count proxy where a time-based primitive exists. It is currently zero-impact (heals carry no magnitude, the block is in the non-default mode, and no on-recovery consumer is in any graded comp), and the substitution IS flagged ☑2 — but the flag's justification is wrong, which would mislead the next author. Ranked lowest of the findings; does not gate GO.

gotchas.summary: The Ninjutsu IFAK all-ally heal is triggered on hitCount 200 as a proxy for the kit's explicit 'every 4 sec', and the override note justifies this by claiming no timed-interval trigger exists — but the engine has one.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: '■ Affects self every 4 sec while in Ninjutsu Injection status.' Driver override skill2 block 4: {trigger:{kind:'hitCount',count:200}, target:'allies', effects:[{kind:'heal'}]}; driver note ☑2: 'no timed-interval trigger exists'. game-mechanics.md §9: 'Engine: the `interval` trigger fires every N sec, first at t=N' (carrier: snow-white S2a, 15s); damage-calculation.md §2b repeats it. S6 blind independently authored {trigger:{kind:'interval',sec:4}}, and S2b specified interval sec:4 with an assertion on steady 4s periodicity.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Replace the trigger with {kind:'interval', sec:4} (first fire t=4 per the ☑ phase convention) and rewrite ☑2 to flag only what is genuinely unmeasured — whether the stored heal releases on the 4s boundary or re-arms after a gap. Do NOT keep the round-count proxy: it drifts with MG wind-up, reloads and any attack-speed support, which a real 4s timer does not.

verdictRationale: The S5 blind test file runs GREEN against the driver's shipped override (22 passed / 5 documented-inert skips / 0 failed) after fixture-plumbing repairs that left every independent assertion untouched, and the S6 blind override is byte-identical on all of skill1 and behaviorally identical on the entire burst slot — so all nine load-bearing lines from the S2b spec converge across two model families. Discrimination holds: each damage-relevant line has a counterfactual that actually moves the log (12% re-keyed to burstCast jumps off the FB-start frames; stripping the 8% collapses the nuke's taken 1.0800->1.0000; stripping the +20% collapses distributed 1.2000->1.0000; the casterAtkPct->atkPct rewrite moves liter's total), and the burst-cast boundary rule is verified by measurement (fbMajorApplied never true, taken 1.08 not 1.20) rather than by the omitted noFb flag. One real gotcha survives, ranked lowest severity: the IFAK team heal uses a hitCount-200 proxy for the kit's explicit 'every 4 sec' and defends it with a false claim that no interval trigger exists — the primitive is documented in both mechanics SSOTs and used by snow-white, and the blind override reached for it unprompted. It is currently zero-impact (heals carry no magnitude, the block sits in the non-default mode, no on-recovery consumer is in any graded comp), so it does not gate GO, but it should be swapped to {interval, sec:4} before any heal-consumer comp is graded. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the driver's fixture makes dnt the SOLE Burst II unit, so she casts in every Full Burst — which means the 12%-vs-8% trigger split is discriminated by FRAME (cast 292 vs FB-start 344) but never by COUNT. S2b's sharper test — her 40s burst cooldown producing FB rotations she does not cast, where only the 12% should appear — is not exercised anywhere in the suite; a two-B2 fixture would close that gap. Second residual: the shipped default mode is 'solo defender', which is the wrong formation branch in the stock control comp (crown is a Defender); it is damage-inert today and flagged ☑3, but it will need per-comp selection the moment shields or heals gain a pool.
